prompt: Complete firstLongerThan, which returns an Optional holding the first word strictly longer than the given length, or an empty Optional when no word qualifies.
explanation: The method returns Optional<String> so the no-match case is explicit in the type instead of relying on null. Returning Optional.of(word) inside the loop stops the search at the first qualifying word, and Optional.empty() after the loop covers the case where nothing qualified. Callers can then use orElse or isPresent without any null checks.
hints: Loop over the array with an enhanced for loop and test word.length() > len -- strictly greater, so equal lengths do not count.
Return Optional.of(word) as soon as a match is found; returning ends the search at the first qualifying word.
If the loop finishes without returning, no word qualified -- return Optional.empty().
